description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of six distinct categories based on their respective counts, with each slice labeled by category name, percentage, and absolute count as provided in the legend. The largest segment, colored light red, represents “chat” at 41.2% (546,526 instances), followed by “math” in blue at 21.9% (290,496). The “tooluse” category, shown in light green, accounts for 11.6% (154,358), while “multi turn chat” in light orange constitutes 9.3% (123,615), though its label is partially obscured in the image. The “code” category, in light purple, makes up 9.0% (119,563), and “instruction follow,” in pink, represents 6.9% (91,460). The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of the “chat” category, which occupies nearly half the pie, while the remaining categories are proportionally smaller, with percentages decreasing in order from “math” down to “instruction follow.” A legend in the upper left corner matches each category to its color and count, reinforcing the visual segmentation.
